description: Northern Ocean Ltd. provides offshore contract drilling services for the oil and gas industry worldwide. The company owns and operates one semi-submersible rig. It also invests in power generation solutions. The company offers integrated drilling services, including rig preparation, mobilization, demobilization, and add-on services. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Hamilton, Bermuda.
